definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining the named belowZeroLoopBody proof term as the exact loop-body constructor sequence.
definitions.text:
rule belowZeroLoopBody
    => AugAssign(Name("balance"), "+", Name("operation"))
       If(Compare(Name("balance"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
          Return(Bool(true)) .Stmts,
          .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining the named belowZeroFunctionBody proof term as the translated function-body constructor sequence.
definitions.text:
rule belowZeroFunctionBody
    => Assign(Name("balance"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("operation"), Int(0))
       For(Name("operation"), Name("operations"), belowZeroLoopBody)
       Return(Bool(false))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining solutionProgram as the translated module term used by the top-level claim.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram
    => Module(
         ImportFrom("typing", "List")
         FuncDef("below_zero", Params("operations"), belowZeroFunctionBody))

definitions.rationale: Base equation of the prefixBelow mathematical contract recurrence for an empty operation sequence.
Recursive equation defining prefixBelow on a head operation and the remaining integer sequence.
definitions.text:
rule prefixBelow(B:Int, intCons(I:Int, IS:IntVals))
    => #if B +Int I <Int 0
       #then true
       #else prefixBelow(B +Int I, IS)
       #fi

operational_rules.rationale: Execution rule observing the empty symbolic integer-list carrier through the iterator protocol and producing #iterDone.
Execution rule observing a nonempty symbolic integer-list carrier through the iterator protocol and yielding its typed head and tail.

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: The exact loop-summary transition is first proved as the AUX-SPEC claim against MPY-VERIFICATION, which excludes this rule, before prove.sh compiles MPY-VERIFICATION-LEMMA and reuses the rule for MAIN-SPEC.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule
    <k> #loop(list(asValSeq(IS:IntVals)), Name("operation"), belowZeroLoopBody)
         ~> (Return(Bool(false)) .Stmts) ~> #endcall
      => prefixBelow(B, IS)
    </k>
    <env> 1 => 0 </env>
    <scopes>
      0 |-> scope(MODULE:Map, parent(-1))
      -1 |-> BUILTINS:Scope
      1 |-> scope(
        "operations" |-> list(asValSeq(INPUT:IntVals))
        "operation"  |-> OLD:Val
        "balance"    |-> B:Int,
        parent(0))
      =>
      0 |-> scope(MODULE, parent(-1))
      -1 |-> BUILTINS
    </scopes>
    <scopeLoc> 2 => 1 </scopeLoc>
    <heap> HEAP:Map </heap>
    <heapLoc> NEXT:Int </heapLoc>
    <stack> ListItem(frame(.K, 0, 1)) => .List </stack>
    <ret> noRet </ret>
    <exc> NoExc </exc>
    <exit-code> 0 </exit-code>
    [priority(40)]
